name: ZipSplat
definition: A feed-forward method that reconstructs scenes from unposed, uncalibrated images as compact, observation-grounded scene tokens, each derived from a source patch and decoded into freely placed Gaussians. The reconstruction budget is adjustable at inference without retraining.
summary: ZipSplat reconstructs scenes from unposed images using compact tokens derived from image patches, enabling adjustable reconstruction budgets at inference without retraining.
